entity.name: Matthew Busel / Tensorust LLC
entity.description: Tensorust LLC is a New York company owned and run by Matthew Busel, who writes and maintains its open source libraries: fin-primitives (exact-decimal trading indicators for Rust and Python), llm-prices (a dated, source-cited LLM API price table), us-restricted-parties (US restricted-party lists as daily machine-readable releases) and sbom-attest (build-time SBOMs and provenance for Rust and C/C++). Funding pays for maintainer time: releases, bug fixes, security work, documentation and keeping data current. More at https://tensorust.com

projects.name: sbom-attest
projects.description: Build-time SBOMs for mixed Rust and C/C++ embedded builds: CycloneDX 1.6 and SPDX 2.3 with the CISA 2026 minimum elements, a diff between a vendor-supplied SBOM and an independently generated one, signed in-toto/SLSA provenance, and a DoWI 8430.01 evidence bundle.

channels.description: One-time or monthly sponsorship through GitHub Sponsors.

plans.name: Sponsor the maintainer
plans.description: Any amount, one-time or monthly, through GitHub Sponsors. Pays for maintainer time on releases, bug fixes and issue triage.

plans.name: Company support
plans.description: For teams shipping embedded firmware: fund support for another build system or toolchain, or get help producing SBOM evidence. Pay by invoice or through the Tensorust shop.
